side.noProjectsList: No projects yet. Click "New project" at the top right.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: LLM provider, API key, language and theme.
settings.llmSectionDesc: Pick a provider. API key is stored locally and encrypted.
settings.ollamaNoKey: Ollama runs locally — no API key needed.

accessMode.label: Billing mode
accessMode.paygHint: Pay per token actually consumed — no monthly fee.
accessMode.planHint: Flat monthly fee for a token quota. Only available for providers that publish a plan endpoint.

settings.planKeyMismatchHint: Plan keys usually start with {{prefix}}. This string doesn't look like one — likely pasted from the wrong bucket.
settings.baseUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the default; set to hit this URL directly
settings.baseUrlHint: Point this at a corporate proxy / third-party gateway. Highest priority — overrides billing-mode endpoints.
settings.customModelHint: Model not in the list? Type its id exactly as the provider documents it — it will be sent to the API verbatim.
settings.modelHint: Different models from the same provider may differ widely in context, price, and capability
settings.customOpenAIDesc: Use any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. You can fetch models first, then still edit the model name manually.
settings.customVendorPlaceholder: e.g. OpenRouter, One API, internal gateway
settings.customModelFetchHint: Try fetching models from the endpoint first. If the service does not support listing, you can still enter the model name manually.
settings.fillBaseUrlFirst: Please enter the API base URL
settings.modelOllamaHint: Ollama model name = whatever shows in your local `ollama list`
settings.rawDumpDescription: Persist each turn's full request body + SSE chunks to logs/raw-llm/<conv-id>/ for postmortem. Authorization headers are auto-redacted. Only the 20 newest conversations are kept; older ones auto-clean. Default ON in community edition.

wizard.providerDesc: Key stored in OS keychain. Switch or add more anytime.
wizard.accessModeIntro: This provider also offers a token plan — switch any time.
wizard.doneDesc: After entering, go to Projects and click + New project: pick the ERP, enter DB credentials, then choose an accounting database from the dropdown.

projects.intro: Each project binds one ERP connection. Agent metadata queries use the currently active project.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Click “New project” and enter the ERP connection details.
projects.name: Name
projects.encryptHint: SQL Server 2022+ requires TLS; keep on unless talking to older servers
projects.trustCertHint: On for local dev; off when the DB has a CA-issued cert
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project? The connection will be torn down.
projects.bosIntro: Same login flow you use to sign in to K/3 Cloud — server URL, account-set, username, password. OpenDeploy uses this for all metadata queries and extension development; no VPN or DB direct-connect required.
projects.bosBaseUrlHint: System endpoint, e.g. http://localhost/k3cloud. Click “Discover account-sets” after filling.
projects.bosBaseUrlFirst: Fill the server URL above first
projects.bosUsernameHint: Local account (e.g. demo / admin) — not a phone number
projects.bosDevCodeHint: ISV identifier issued by Kingdee Cosmic Dev Platform; defaults to PAIJ
projects.noDatabases: No user databases visible on this server

captcha.intro: The server requires a login CAPTCHA. Type the 4 characters from the image (case-insensitive).
captcha.refreshHint: Can't read it? Get a new one

skills.intro: Skills are markdown instructions the agent loads on demand. Each skill's description tells the agent when to use it.
skills.empty: No skills yet. The installer seeds the built-in bundle on first launch, or click “Check for updates” to pull from the official repo.
